plan.notes: Source: official FIU Knight Foundation School of Computing and Information Sciences 'Plan of Study' PDF for the Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Computer Science Track, downloaded 2026-09-30 from https://www.cis.fiu.edu/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/CS-Plan-of-Study.pdf (server Last-Modified 2024-08-20). Catalog year: 2024-2025, the currently published edition on the official school site. STALENESS DISCLOSURE: the document footer stamps 'Rev 07/2017', but the course content (CIS 3950/4951 Capstone I/II at 1+2 credits, ENC 3249, COT 3541, COP 4710, CNT 4713, CDA 3103) matches the post-2022 curriculum and the official Rev 4/2023 CS-Track flowchart effective Fall 2023 (https://dev.cis.fiu.edu/wp-content/uploads/undergrad-flowcharts/CS/CS-BS.pdf), so the footer is a stale artifact, not the content vintage. Transcription method: manual, verbatim, course-by-course from the four year-blocks (Freshman/Sophomore/Junior/Senior, 30 credits each); every code, title, and credit value is verbatim from the PDF. CAVEATS: (1) The source is organized by academic YEAR, not by term; each year was split into Fall/Spring terms of ~15 credits in the document's listed order, which is prerequisite-consistent (cross-checked against the Rev 4/2023 flowchart's prereq lines: MAC 2311->MAC 2312->STA 3033, COP 2210->COP 3337->COP 3530/COP 4338, PHY 2048->PHY 2049, CIS 3950->CIS 4951). The Fall/Spring split within each year is the collector's disclosed inference. (2) The source lists no per-course prerequisites, so prereq arrays are empty (sibling-plan convention). (3) Cross-source discrepancy: the Rev 4/2023 flowchart places CIS 3950 Capstone I in junior year ('Junior standing'); the Plan of Study lists both capstones under Senior Year - transcribed as the Plan of Study states. (4) The flowchart shows 'Natural Science Group 1/2 Elective (See Advisor)' where the Plan of Study lists PHY 2048/2049 plus two 'CS Science Elective' slots - transcribed from the Plan of Study. (5) Per the plan's footnotes, students must earn at least nine credit hours in summer semesters within the Florida State University System and students deficient in a foreign language must include a two-semester sequence in one foreign language among general electives - not modeled as terms. (6) The BS in Computer Science has two tracks (Computer Science and Software Design and Development); this plan is the Computer Science Track, matching catalog program COMPSC:BS (Diploma Title: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science). Placeholder slots (UCC Courses, CS Science Elective, CS Elective, General Electives) are student-choice courses - see the choice notes and an advisor. Credit sum verified: 120.
